Messages.Author: Powerlord
Messages.Body:


Hi, only two, the 2 votes she already has is itself a title.

Remember, she cannot became anarch by herself, because she is already
a title vampire, once she becames anarch she will lose her votes and
will be a valid target to became an anarch Baron.

Also note that:
- an independent vampire cannot recieve the baron title while he is
not anarch
- titled vampires cannot "change" into anarch as a non-titled vampire
(through the +1 stealth action)
- a laibon, sabbat or camarilla non-titled vampire can take the action
to became anarch
- a non-titled vampire that has "additional votes" recieved by other
means (legendary vampire, Black Hand Emissary, Emergency Powers,
Political Struggle, Kduva's Mask, Lyndhurst Estate, etc) does not
count as a titled vampire and those votes do not count as title, so he
will add this votes to his title.

Ricardo Marta
Prince of Lisboa
Portugal

From 10.5 of the rulebook:

An untitled non-anarch vampire can become an anarch as a +1 stealth
action that costs 2 blood (or 1 blood if the controller controls at
least 1 other ready anarch).

--------------------------------------------

An independent titled vampire could not take this action to become
anarch because of their title.

A quick look at various other means to go anarch:

Go Anarch
+1 stealth action. Requires a ready non-titled, non-anarch vampire.
Put this card on the acting vampire and untap this vampire. This
vampire is considered anarch (and independent). If this vampire
changes sects, burn this card.

Galaric's Legacy
Master. Trifle.
Put this card on a ready non-titled, non-anarch vampire you control.
The vampire with this card is considered anarch (and independent). If
this vampire changes sects, burn this card.

Twilight Camp
Master.
Put this card in play with 4 counters. When you put a non-titled, non-
anarch vampire in play from your uncontrolled region, you may burn a
counter from this card to make that vampire anarch (and independent).
You may burn a counter from this card to add a blood to an anarch as a
master phase action. Burn this card when it has no counters.

Seattle Committee
Unique master.
Put this card in play. During your master phase, you may tap this card
to put an anarch counter on a ready non-titled, non-anarch vampire you
control. A vampire with an anarch counter is considered anarch (and
independent) even if this card leaves play. If a vampire with an
anarch counter changes sects, burn the counter.
----------------------------------------

All of these ways to become anarch exclude titled vampires, just like
the basic action to become an anarch.

Anarch Secession
+1 stealth action. Requires a ready, non-anarch, titled vampire.
Put an anarch counter on this acting vampire. This vampire becomes
anarch (and Independent). If he or she had a city title, put this card
on him or her as a title card to represent the title of baron of the
same city. Minions without titles cannot block this action. Burn the
anarch counter if this vampire changes sects.
-----------------------------------------

This requires a titled vampire, regardless of sect. When a vampire
changes sects, their title is suppressed. Since anarchs belong to the
"Independent" sect, what you are saying is that they don't lost their
title, right? Does this mean that independent titles are not
independent, non-anarch titles, but purely independent titles? This
may sound intuitive, and maybe it's just a loophole that I hadn't
caught before, but I thought that titled independent vampires lost
their titles when they went independent. Good stuff.

Jack Drake
Brujah
8-capacity, group 4
CEL POT pre tha
Independent. Anarch: When you put a younger vampire in play from your
uncontrolled region, that vampire may burn a blood to become anarch.
+1 strength.
-------------------------------------------------------

So Jack Drake can make Kashan (7 capacity, 1 vote(titled) independent
vampire), along with Maureen, Dark Priestess, Daniele Diron(1 vote),
Don Michael Antionio Giovanni(2 votes), and Mata Hari(2 votes) anarchs
that retain their independent titles through his special ability.

Are there any other means of titled independent vampires becoming
anarch I'm missing?

Thanks,

Brandon

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
brandonsantacruz wrote:
> Anarch Secession

>
> This requires a titled vampire, regardless of sect. When a vampire
> changes sects, their title is suppressed.

Only if changing to a sect inappropriate for the title.
That is, only if the title is sect-specific.

Similarly, changing clans will suppress a title if the title is clan-based (like
"Brujah Justicar").

Camarilla titles are sect-specific, as the name implies. [10.1]
Sabbat titles are, too. [10.2]
Laibon titles, too. [10.3]

The anonymous titles that some Independent vampires have on their card text ("Me
has 2 votes") are not restricted like the sect-based named titles.

>Since anarchs belong to the
> "Independent" sect, what you are saying is that they don't lost their
> title, right?

Right.

> Does this mean that independent titles are not
> independent, non-anarch titles, but purely independent titles?

They're just titles. They're not linked to sect in any way.

> This
> may sound intuitive, and maybe it's just a loophole that I hadn't
> caught before, but I thought that titled independent vampires lost
> their titles when they went independent. Good stuff.

Indy can't "go" Indy. They just stay Indy.

> So Jack Drake can make Kashan (7 capacity, 1 vote(titled) independent
> vampire), along with Maureen, Dark Priestess, Daniele Diron(1 vote),
> Don Michael Antionio Giovanni(2 votes), and Mata Hari(2 votes) anarchs
> that retain their independent titles through his special ability.

Yeah.

Yes (same as Acceptance question above).

> In that situation, if she were the Baron of Corte instead of
> having her regular title, would she lose her title when she became
> Camarilla?

Yes. [10.5]

> I'm sure this has been addressed before, but where in this process is
> her title lost vs when is it suppressed?

Gain a title => lose your old title. [10]
Card text says lose a title => lose the title.
Change to a sect/clan/non-anarch state not appropriate for your title: suppress
the title [10].
